resources.description: Актуальные API мира. ID замените данными из ответов API. Для команды сначала выполните соответствующий preview с теми же параметрами, затем скопируйте quote_id и полный expected_revisions в переменные этой папки. expected_revisions — строка с JSON-объектом, подставляемая без кавычек. Для новой команды задайте новый world_request_key; при повторе после потери ответа сохраняйте ключ и тело. Суммы Cr передаются строками. Инструкция: docs/api/insomnia.md.

resources.name: POST /world/nodes/{id}/building-pause-preview
resources.description: Источник: docs/api/world-building-operation.openapi.json. Requires world_read, world_write and storage_v2. Only active <-> paused for a ready owned building with at most 100 own rooms. No shelter, nested plot/building, active construction or foreign lodger. Pause closes current housing intervals; resume does not reassign lodging. Station use and incoming storage operations follow existing building access policy; withdrawal remains available. Equipment exposure, budgets, treasury and debts are unchanged. No charge. Preview expires after 300 seconds; commit revalidates under existing locks, with audit and outbox. Same request key replays the original result. Сначала выполните preview, затем перенесите quote_id и expected_revisions. Для новой команды задайте новый world_request_key; при повторе используйте прежний ключ и тело.

resources.name: POST /world/nodes/{id}/building-repair
resources.description: Источник: docs/api/world-building-repair.openapi.json. Requires world_write, storage_v2 and active exact wallet. Fixed effective contract from purchase or accepted supplement; ceil(full_price * damage / max_condition) at 0.0001 Cr, ceil each raw material to whole units. Building budget pays original settlement treasury. Personal balance unchanged. Materials only from accessible backpack slots. Only own ready/paused/damaged buildings with own rooms and no construction/shelter/nested estate. Destroyed/archived buildings cannot be repaired. Damaged or stopped buildings remain paused; no lodging restored. Healthy active lodging is preserved. All transfers, consumption, condition, revisions, audit and outbox share a transaction; same key replays original result. Сначала выполните preview, затем перенесите quote_id и expected_revisions. Для новой команды задайте новый world_request_key; при повторе используйте прежний ключ и тело.

resources.name: GET /world/nodes/{id}/finance-hierarchy
resources.description: Источник: docs/api/world-finance-hierarchy.openapi.json. world_read and actual root ownership required. Follow economy_parent_rule/history current links (matching history/subject/revision, effective_to null), never world_node.parent_id. Apply ownership and WorldAccessPolicy before limits and traversal; stop at foreign/hidden/archived nodes and never jump over them. Only node subjects with Cr budget/treasury are included; loss sinks, assets/NPC accounts and personal wallets excluded. Internal transfers contribute zero net boundary flow. Lifetime historical transfers are classified using current membership; this is not an as-of historical consolidation. REPEATABLE READ snapshot for membership, balances, ledger, counts and members. No writes, provisioning, collection, catch-up jobs or hierarchy repair.

resources.name: GET /world/nodes/{id}/finance-report
resources.description: Источник: docs/api/world-finance-report.openapi.json. world_read and actual ownership required. Does not need wallet/storage activation. A REPEATABLE READ snapshot keeps balances/totals/count/items coherent. Query uses only this node budget and treasury; world loss sink and descendant accounts are excluded. Internal transfers appear once. Foreign account IDs, foreign balances, user IDs and operation IDs are not returned. All totals are over the whole lifetime, even when the journal is filtered; sort is fixed descending ID. GET does not collect, repair balances, settle losses, create accounts or enqueue jobs.

Night illness requires a separately published calendar. Сначала выполните preview, затем перенесите quote_id и expected_revisions. resources.name: GET /world/nodes/{id}/treasury-receipts
resources.description: Источник: docs/api/world-treasury-receipts.openapi.json. world_read required; no wallet/storage activation needed for reading. One REPEATABLE READ transaction without write/registry locks provides coherent rows and aggregate collected/lost amounts for up to 20 receipts. Receipt original = remaining + collected + lost; recorded losses are not projected losses. Published new policies do not change old receipt rules. Projection covers one period only; delayed worker may owe multiple periods. No cross-world financial totals or revenue classification is provided.
